CHECK_CWRR=false resets/exports zero wat_flux by original source; all three explicit true full-source tuples were rejected and are excluded from numerical acceptance.

Cases 108/109 retain their initial names/inputs 35/125; with source soilc_max=130000 these are small organic fractions, not saturated. New cases119/120 separately test mixed/full fractions.
